answer: Session keys expire after 200 signed operations. Renewal requires a fresh graded submission, not a payment. A failed audit slashes the stake behind the key and publishes the slash for 30 days. So a cloned fleet must keep 200 useful operations per key alive, across a grove of accounts that each need distinct work. One operator with 500 keys needs 100,000 graded operations per cycle; the meadow of idle accounts dries out, and the summit is a queue no bot shortcuts.
